#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class MinCostMaxFlow {
public:
    struct Edge {
        int u, flow, rid, cost;
        Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d) : u(a), flow(b), cost(c), rid(d) {}
    };
    vector<vector<Edge>> al;
    vector<Edge*> ja[1005];
    int d[1005];
    int N, S, T, maxFlow, minCost;
    const int gmax = INT_MAX / 1000;
    int edges = 0;

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
        int lu = al[u].size(), lv = al[v].size();
        al[u].push_back(Edge(v, flow, cost, lv));
        al[v].push_back(Edge(u, 0, -cost, lu));
    }

    void convertToArray() {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            int sz = al[i].size();
            ja[i].resize(sz);
            for (int j = 0; j < sz; j++) {
                ja[i][j] = &al[i][j];
            }
            al[i].clear();
        }
    }

    MinCostMaxFlow(int n, int source, int sink) {
        N = n; S = source; T = sink; maxFlow = 0; minCost = 0;
        al.resize(N);
        fill(d, d + N, 0);
    }

    bool BellmanFord(bool check) {
        d[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N - 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                for (auto e : ja[j]) {
                    if (e->flow == 0) continue;
                    d[e->u] = min(d[e->u], d[j] + e->cost);
                }
            }
        }
        if (check) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                for (auto e : ja[j]) {
                    if (e->flow == 0) continue;
                    if (d[j] + e->cost < d[e->u]) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    int node[1005];
    int visit[1005];
    int prv[1005], prve[1005];
    int dist[1005];

    bool simple() {
        fill(node, node + N, 0);
        fill(visit, visit + N, 0);
        fill(prv, prv + N, 0);
        fill(prve, prve + N, 0);
        fill(dist, dist + N, gmax);

        node[0] = S; dist[0] = 0;
        int front = 1, back = 0;
        while (front != back) {
            int u = node[back++];
            int distu = dist[u];
            if (back == N) back = 0;
            visit[u] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)ja[u].size(); i++) {
                Edge* e = ja[u][i];
                if (e->flow == 0) continue;
                int cdist = distu + e->cost;
                if (cdist < dist[e->u]) {
                    if (visit[e->u] == 0) {
                        node[front] = e->u;
                        if (++front == N) front = 0;
                    } else if (visit[e->u] == 2) {
                        if (--back == -1) back += N;
                        node[back] = e->u;
                    }
                    visit[e->u] = 1;
                    prve[e->u] = i;
                    prv[e->u] = u;
                    dist[e->u] = cdist;
                }
            }
        }
        return visit[T] != 0;
    }

    bool dijkstra() {
        fill(visit, visit + N, 0);
        fill(prv, prv + N, 0);
        fill(prve, prve + N, 0);
        fill(dist, dist + N, gmax);
        priority_queue<pair<int, int>, vector<pair<int, int>>, greater<pair<int, int>>> pq;

        pq.push({0, S});
        dist[0] = 0;
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            int cd = p.first, u = p.second;
            if (cd != dist[u]) continue;
            visit[u] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)ja[u].size(); i++) {
                Edge* e = ja[u][i];
                if (e->flow == 0) continue;
                int cdist = cd + (e->cost + d[u] - d[e->u]);
                if (cdist < dist[e->u]) {
                    if (visit[e->u] == 2) return false;
                    pq.push({cdist, e->u});
                    dist[e->u] = cdist;
                    prv[e->u] = u;
                    prve[e->u] = i;
                    visit[e->u] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return visit[T] != 0;
    }

    int augment() {
        int p = T;
        int minVal = gmax;
        while (p != 0) {
            int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
            minVal = min(minVal, ja[pp][pe]->flow);
            p = pp;
        }
        p = T;
        while (p != 0) {
            int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
            ja[pp][pe]->flow -= minVal;
            ja[p][ja[pp][pe]->rid]->flow += minVal;
            p = pp;
        }
        maxFlow += minVal;
        return minVal;
    }

    bool calSimple() {
        while (simple()) {
            minCost += dist[T] * augment();
        }
        return true;
    }

    void updPotential() {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (visit[i] != 0) {
                d[i] += dist[i] - dist[S];
            }
        }
    }

    bool calWithPotential() {
        while (dijkstra()) {
            int minVal = dist[T] + d[T] - d[S];
            minCost += minVal * augment();
            updPotential();
        }
        return true;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    int maxl = n + k;
    int T = n * maxl + 1;
    MinCostMaxFlow ans(T + 1, 0, T);
    vector<int> a(k + 1), f(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
        f[a[i]]++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (f[i] == 0) continue;
        ans.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
    }
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
            ans.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
            for (int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                if (a != 1)
                    ans.addEdge(n * l + a, n * (l + 1) + b, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                if (b != 1)
                    ans.addEdge(n * l + b, n * (l + 1) + a, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int l = 1; l < maxl; l++) {
        ans.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
    }
    ans.convertToArray();
    ans.calWithPotential();
    if (ans.maxFlow != k) {
        cout << "BUG" << endl;
    } else {
        cout << (int)ans.minCost << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
